description: Find Nova Poshta branches and parcel lockers in a Ukrainian city where a RoutersUA order can be collected, from the directory the store checkout uses. Use it when the user asks where to collect an order or which point is near them; for ship and delivery dates use routersua_estimate_delivery, and for delivery cost and payment routersua_get_store_policy. If the city name matches several places, the result lists them; call again with city_ref. At most 30 points come back; more_points true means there are more, so narrow with query. An unknown city returns an error.

city.description: City or village name in Ukrainian or Russian, e.g. "Київ", "Одеса", "Львів". Give city or city_ref.

city_ref.description: The ref of a city from the cities list of an earlier result, to pick one of several matches.

query.description: A branch or locker number (73) or part of the address (a street name) to narrow the list.

type.description: branch for Nova Poshta branches and partner points, locker for parcel lockers, all for both.

name: routersua_find_delivery_points
title: Find Nova Poshta delivery points
